subject: Ephemeral proofing window + test-case provisioning plan (Arcadia)
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@arcadiahealth.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataScienceOps <datascienceops@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short evaluation window + sample test cases

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week — the latency/cost numbers looked promising. The evaluation committee at Arcadia wants to run a "proofing" pass on a small set of clinical triage prompts and supporting test cases, but they're sensitive about PHI and retention. Before we get the security team to sign off, a couple of asks so we can map timelines: 

1) Can Redwood provide a short-lived (ephemeral) access window for a 14-day sandbox where our team can run prompt packs and seed test cases?
2) We need explicit usage constraints: no persistence beyond the window, no redistribution, and confirmation that you will not use the seed test cases for model training.
3) What's the typical mechanism for delivering testcases and prompt packs securely (S3 presigned URL, secure transfer, or tenant upload)?

If this is feasible we'll route a quick security questionnaire and aim to start the eval the week of Mar 1. Appreciate any sample MAP or timeline you can share.

Best,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Data Science, Arcadia Health

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: DataScienceOps <datascienceops@arcadiahealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short evaluation window + sample test cases

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear asks, and glad the walkthrough was useful. Short answer: yes, we can do an ephemeral sandbox with narrow usage constraints. I pulled together a one-page plan and a draft MAP for timelines and gating. See attached: Redwood_EPHEMERAL_ACCESS_PLAN_v1.pdf (high-level), and a watermarked prompt pack sample we can provision for you. Key points: 

- Access window: configurable; we usually do 7, 14, or 21 days. For Arcadia I'd recommend 14 days as you requested.
- Data handling guarantees: we will mark the tenant’s sandbox as time-limited and run a retention job to purge KV cache and disk artifacts 24 hours after the window closes. We will not use uploaded testcases for model training—this will be stated in the MAP and covered by the DPA addendum.
- Delivery: secure S3 presigned URLs for the package upload, or we can provide a tenant-only upload endpoint. For downloads of sample prompt packs we'll provide a watermarked ZIP.
- Access model: ephemeral API keys scoped to the sandbox routes (read/write limited), and network-bound to Arcadia IP ranges if you require it.

I copied Marissa from our CS/Onboarding team to help with provisioning logistics and Karthik for legal/MPA check-ins. Once you confirm, we can send a DocuSign link for the data processing addendum and schedule the provisioning run (usually 48–72 hours lead time).

Next steps: if you confirm 14 days and agree to the non-training/no-redistribution clause, I'll kick off the MAP and provisioning checklist.

Cheers,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:27:00 -08:00
Subject: internal: review access plan and DPA flow (Arcadia)

Aisha / Karthik — quick internal thread before we send any DocuSign links. A few risk items from CS/legal: 

- Confirm that the purge job will remove any KV cache of model prefixes that arose during evaluation (not just stored files). Engineering notes: we need to run the purge with a cache flush + disk wipe flag.
- Watermarking: we'll provide a promptpack ZIP with a per-download watermark (filename header + checksum) to discourage external redistribution. Is that acceptable to Arcadia?
- DPA: suggest adding a short clause that disallows downstream model training with exchanged materials and requires confirmation if Arcadia later requests longer retention.

Karthik — if you can draft the clause language, I can attach it to the DocuSign package. Aisha — please hold the provisioning step until DocuSign is completed unless Arcadia signs an exception.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: internal: review access plan and DPA flow (Arcadia)

Thanks Marissa — draft clause below (inline) for inclusion in the DPA/MPA: 

"Arcadia Health will provide evaluation datasets and related prompt packs to Redwood Inference strictly for the purpose of a time-limited evaluation. Redwood agrees not to (i) use provided datasets to improve or re-train models; (ii) redistribute datasets to third parties; and (iii) retain evaluation datasets beyond the mutually agreed ephemeral window except as required by law. Redwood will permanently delete cached model state related to those datasets within 24 hours after window close and provide a confirmation report on deletion on request."

Alice — copying the language here for visibility. If that looks good, we will append it to the DocuSign DPA and proceed.

—Karthik
Lead Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@arcadiahealth.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ephemeral proofing window + test-case provisioning plan (Arcadia)

Hi team — this is good and aligns with what our security policy requires. A few clarifying points before we sign: 

- Confirmation we will receive a deletion report (hashes and timestamps) within 72 hours of purge completion.
- For the testcases we will upload: can you limit retrieval to read-only for our evaluation keys (no server-side copy by Redwood beyond ephemeral caching)?
- We prefer presigned S3 uploads (we will push encrypted archives from our side). If you can send a secure upload link plus the DocuSign DPA link, we can sign and schedule the run for Mar 1.

Once DocuSign is in place we approve the 14-day window and the usage constraints. Please send the links and a one-page MAP with milestone dates (DocuSign sent -> provisioning -> evidence purge) so our procurement can close.

Thanks — looking forward to the quick turnaround.

Alice
Head of Data Science, Arcadia Health
